1,3-H shift of the N-H cis to C=O (map H5) onto O3. Formally verified through ts_prepare run ts/ts_0003: exactly one imaginary mode -1897.79 cm-1, and both actual IRC outer frames optimized independently to zero-imaginary-frequency minima with the declared identities (formamide side and formimidic acid c3 side). Logs: ts/ts_0003/jobs/declaration_0001/ts_opt/refine.log, frequency/frequency.log, irc/irc.log, product_frequency/; guess from the relaxed scan maximum of calc/A/scan_NH_to_OH.log

formimidic acid global minimum, HO-C=N-H syn/anti (tau(HO-C=N)=0, tau(OC=N-H)=180), 0 imaginary frequencies; this is the conformer the TS1 IRC reaches. Other verified conformers: c1 -169.745424093 (calc/A/fi_c1.log, syn/syn), c2 -169.744844853 (calc/A/fi_c2_OHanti_NHsyn.log, O-H anti/N-H syn), c4 -169.741299930 (calc/A/fi_c4_OHanti_NHanti.log)

conformational transition of formimidic acid: pure hydroxyl torsion of H6 about the O3-C2 axis (imaginary mode displacements 0.39/0.88 on H6, all other atoms <=0.03), single imaginary frequency -543.04 cm-1 at tau(H-O-C=N)=94.4 deg. Both IRC branches and both re-optimized outer frames are verified: forward -> c3 (OH-syn/NH-anti, -169.751089942), reverse -> c4 (OH-anti/NH-anti, -169.741299799); the N-H never inverts, so this edge is c3 <-> c4 (logs calc/A/tsconf_irc.log, calc/A/tsconf_irc_rev.log, calc/A/tsconf_ircend_fwd_optfreq.log, calc/A/tsconf_ircend_rev_optfreq.log)

formimidic acid OH-anti / N-H-syn rotamer (N-H cis to O), 0 imaginary frequencies: the reactive conformer for dehydration and the minimum the TS2 IRC reaches on the intermediate side (+3.92 kcal/mol above FI). It differs from FI/FIC by the N-H orientation, i.e. it is NOT reachable by the pure C-O torsion TSCONF; the in-plane N-H reorientation between the NH-anti and NH-syn families was not located in this study. Edge e3 nevertheless references the bond-changing barrier to the lowest verified minimum of this state (FI), as required

concerted elimination from formimidic acid: N-H (map H4) transfers to O3 while C2-O3 breaks and C=N becomes C#N; freq log ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0005/frequency/frequency.log (-1925.1662), IRC ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0005/irc/irc.log with IRC outer-frame minima ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0005/reactant_opt/reactant_opt.log (-169.744844939) and the HCN...H2O product. A second conformer channel (ts/ts_0002, from the O-H syn / N-H syn rotamer) relaxes to the same saddle (-169.641371482, imag -1923.68), so only one dehydration saddle exists
